svg.title: NoriShell on Android preview
svg.desc: Illustration of three phone screens of the NoriShell Android preview. The first shows a terminal with a current-tab pill, a tab counter and a plus button, shell output, an extra-keys row and bottom navigation. The second shows the server overview with compact host cards, each with a status dot, a New Terminal action and CPU, memory, disk and network readings. The third shows Settings as a grouped list with a detail page on top.

g.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif
g.text: The same Core and SSH sessions in a single-screen mobile layout.
